# opnsense_bind_settings (Resource)

BIND general settings (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ General**, plugin `os-bind`): listening addresses and port, forwarders, recursion, DNSSEC validation, rate limiting and logging. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `bind_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_bind_settings.this
  id = "bind_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_bind_settings" "this" {
  enabled    = true
  port       = 53530
  forwarders = ["9.9.9.9"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowquery` (Set of String) Define the ACLs where you allow which client are allowed to query this server.
- `allowtransfer` (Set of String) Define the ACLs where you allow which server can retrieve zones.
- `disableprefetch` (Boolean) This will disable prefetching of domains before they time out.
- `disablev6` (Boolean) This will run BIND in IPv4-only mode.
- `dnssecvalidation` (String) Default is "No". Set to "Auto" to use the static trust anchor configuration by the system. One of `no`, `auto`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) This will activate the BIND daemon.
- `enableratelimiting` (Boolean) This will enable rate-limiting for DNS replies.
- `enablerpz` (Boolean) enablerpz.
- `filteraaaaacl` (Set of String) Specifies a list of client addresses for which AAAA filtering is to be applied.
- `filteraaaav4` (Boolean) This will filter AAAA records on IPv4 Clients. Set "DNSSEC Validation" to "No" and AAAA records will be omitted even if they are signed.
- `filteraaaav6` (Boolean) This will filter AAAA records on IPv6 Clients. Set "DNSSEC Validation" to "No" and AAAA records will be omitted even if they are signed.
- `forwarders` (Set of String) Set one or more hosts to send your DNS queries if the request is unknown.
- `general_log_level` (String) Select General Log level. Log levels are listed in the order of increasing verbosity. Setting a certain log level will cause all messages of the specified and more severe log levels to be logged. One of `critical`, `error`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`, `dynamic`.
- `hidehostname` (Boolean) This will hide the system hostname for DNS queries.
- `hideversion` (Boolean) This will hide the local BIND version in DNS queries.
- `listenv4` (Set of String) Set the IPv4 addresses the service should listen to.
- `listenv6` (Set of String) Set the IPv6 addresses the service should listen to.
- `logsize` (Number) Set the amount how big a logfile can growth. For Query and Blocked logs. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `maxcachesize` (Number) How much memory in percent the cache can use from the system. Default is 80%. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `port` (Number) Set the port the service should listen to. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `querysource` (String) Specify the IPv4 address used as a source for outbound queries.
- `querysourcev6` (String) Specify the IPv6 address used as a source for outbound queries.
- `ratelimitcount` (Number) Set how many replies per second are allowed. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `ratelimitexcept` (Set of String) Except a list of IPs from rate-limiting like ::1.
- `recursion` (Set of String) Define an ACL where you allow which clients can resolve via this service. Usually use your local LAN.
- `rndcalgo` (String) Set the authentication algorithm for the RNDC key. This requires a restart of the Bind Service. One of `hmac-sha512`, `hmac-sha384`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha224`, `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-md5`.
- `rndcsecret` (String, Sensitive) The base64-encoded RNDC key. This requires a restart of the Bind Service.
- `transfersource` (String) Specify the IPv4 address used as a source for zone transfers.
- `transfersourcev6` (String) Specify the IPv6 address used as a source for zone transfers.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `bind_settings`.
